what_it_does: Eternal Limited operates technology platforms providing food delivery, quick commerce doorstep delivery across categories, going-out experiences discovery and transactions, and B2B supplies of food ingredients to restaurants. It generates revenue through marketplace commissions and product sales.
other_facts: Consolidated revenue from operations grew 169% YoY to INR 54,364 crore in FY26.
Eternal Limited on a standalone basis has employees working out of 4 directly leased offices and 48 co-working spaces in India and the UAE.
Total export turnover is 0.02% of the total revenue from operations of Eternal Limited for FY26.
